title: 第8章一个月，练气三层
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
日子就这么过起来了。

    白天，废器处理组，干活。公用熔炉，普通手法，提炼精铁，纯度稳定在八成出头。

    赵铁手看在眼里，点头，不说什么。陈青山干完活，擦擦汗，喝口水，跟旁边的人扯两句闲话，该干嘛干嘛。

    晚上，回住处，关好门窗，盘腿坐床上。

    心念一动，火毒废器从识海中取出，投入造化鼎。

    鼎内火焰猛地窜高，红转紫，紫转白。火毒反成了最烈的燃料。不到一刻钟，一块暗红色火精铁“当”一声弹到半空。

    二次提纯。三次提纯。

    火精铁变火铁精，火铁精变火铁元晶。米粒大小，暗红色，捏在指尖微微发烫。

    吸收。

    炽热元气涌入灵脉。灵脉在颤，像被火烤。

    修为往上窜了一丝。

    不多。

    但每天都在涨。

    第一周。十件火毒废器。三斤火精铁，半斤火铁精，七钱火铁元晶。

    修为从二层中期，突破到后期。

    陈青山吸收完最后一块元晶，手心全是汗，呼吸急促，全身像从烤箱里捞出来的。

    嘶——

    疼是真疼。

    爽也是真爽。

    他擦了擦手，把火精铁收好。这东西现在没用，但以后说不定能派上用场。

    第二周。节奏加快。十五件火毒废器，四斤半火精铁，八两火铁精，一两二钱火铁元晶。

    修为从二层后期，一路冲到后期巅峰。

    差一步，就是大圆满。

    这天白天，赵铁手路过他熔炉旁，瞥了一眼他刚出炉的精铁。

    “纯度又涨了。”

    “还行。”

    “八成四了。”赵铁手笑了笑，“大考有戏。保持住。”

    “是。”

    陈青山应着，面上平静。

    平静个屁。

    瓶颈不在白天的熔炼。瓶颈在晚上。

    每天夜里闭眼内视，他都能感觉到那层膜。

    二层的膜，就在前面。薄薄一层，但韧得很，像牛皮糖，怎么拉都不破。

    二十多件火毒废器的元气精华，全灌进去了。量够了。但质不够。

    突破不是靠堆量就能冲开的。需要更纯的东西。

    比火铁元晶更纯的东西。

    可他的灵力容量比同阶多出一大截，突破需要的元气也远超常人。

    操。

    老天爷给你开一扇门，非得再堵一扇窗。

    第三周。火毒废器快用完了。

    准确地说，还剩三件。修为卡在二层大圆满，纹丝不动。

    那天早上，他正在废器场整理精铁，张虎晃过来了。

    “陈青山。”

    “张师兄。”

    “有个活儿。”张虎抱着胳膊，脸上挂着那种“我给你找了个好差事”的笑，“器峰长老们闭关三个月炼法器，攒下一批火毒废器。火毒之浓，炼器学徒都碰不了，前两天已经灼伤了两个。”

    他顿了顿。

    “那批东西没人敢碰。我跟上面说了，分给你处理。后院，三箱。”

    陈青山低下头。

    差点笑出来。

    “……多谢张师兄。”

    “谢我？”张虎瞪大眼，“你脑子没烧坏吧？那玩意儿碰了灼伤灵脉！”

    “弟子有法子在手上隔一层。”陈青山赶紧补了一句，“能处理。”

    张虎上下打量他一番，耸耸肩。

    “你要收就收。死了别赖我。”

    说完走了。

    走到门口停了一下，头也不回：“对了，搬完之后把后院也扫了。灰多。”

    陈青山跟着张虎到了后院。三口木箱堆在墙角，箱体被火毒侵蚀得发暗红，凑近了热浪扑面。

    他蹲下来打开第一口箱子。

    赤红色气息冲出来，灼得他眯了一下眼。
content_en:
The days went on like this.

    During the day, the waste disposal team works. A public furnace uses ordinary methods to refine refined iron, and the purity is stable at just over 80%.

    Zhao Tieshou saw this and nodded without saying anything. After Chen Qingshan finished his work, he wiped his sweat, drank some water, and chatted with the people next to him about what he was doing.

    In the evening, go back to your residence, close the doors and windows, and sit cross-legged on the bed.

    With a thought, the fire-poisoned waste vessel was taken out from the sea of ​​consciousness and thrown into the cauldron of creation.

    The flames in the cauldron suddenly shot up, turning from red to purple, and from purple to white. The poison of fire turned out to be the strongest fuel. In less than a quarter of an hour, a piece of dark red fire iron bounced into the air with a clang.

    Secondary purification. Three times purified.

    The fire essence iron becomes the fire iron essence, and the fire iron essence becomes the fire iron elemental crystal. The size of a grain of rice, dark red, slightly hot when pinched with fingertips.

    absorb.

    Fiery vitality surges into the spiritual veins. His spiritual veins were trembling, as if being roasted by fire.

    His cultivation level has improved a bit.

    not much.

    But it’s rising every day.

    Week one. Ten useless fire-poisoned weapons. Three pounds of fire essence iron, half a pound of fire iron essence, seven coins of fire iron essence.

    The cultivation base has broken through from the middle stage of the second level to the late stage.

    After Chen Qingshan absorbed the last piece of Yuan Jing, his palms were all sweaty, his breathing was rapid, and his whole body looked like it had been fished out of an oven.

    Hiss——

    It hurts. It really hurts.

    It's really cool.

    He wiped his hands and put away the iron. This thing is useless now, but it might come in handy in the future.

    Week two. The pace quickens. Fifteen useless fire-poisoned weapons, four and a half kilograms of fire iron essence, eighty taels of fire iron essence, and one or two cents of fire iron crystal.

    The cultivation base has rushed from the late stage of the second level to the peak of the late stage.

    One step away from it is Dzogchen.

    During the day, Zhao Tieshou passed by his furnace and glanced at the fine iron that had just come out of the furnace.

    "The purity has increased again."

    "It's okay."

    "Eighty-four percent." Zhao Tieshou smiled, "The big exam is going to be exciting. Keep it up."

    "Yes."

    Chen Qingshan responded, his face calm.

    Calm down the ass.

    The bottleneck is not smelting during the day. The bottleneck is at night.

    Every night when he closed his eyes and looked inside, he could feel the membrane.

    The second layer of membrane is right in front. It's a thin layer, but very tough, like brown sugar, and it won't break no matter how you pull it.

    The essence of more than twenty fire-poisoned waste weapons was poured into it. The amount is enough. But the quality is not enough.

    Breakthroughs cannot be achieved by relying on piles of volume. Something purer is needed.

    Something purer than the Fire Iron Crystal.

    But his spiritual power capacity is much greater than that of the same level, and the energy required to break through is far beyond that of ordinary people.

    Hold.

    God opens a door for you, but you have to block a window.

    Week three. The fire poison waste device is almost used up.

    Three left to be exact. The cultivation base is stuck on the second level of Dzogchen and is motionless.

    That morning, he was sorting out fine iron in the scrap yard when Zhang Hu came over.

    "Chen Qingshan."

    "Senior Brother Zhang."

    "I have a job." Zhang Hu crossed his arms with a smile like "I've found a good job for you" on his face. "The elders of Qifeng went into seclusion for three months to refine magic weapons and accumulated a batch of fire-poisoned waste weapons. The fire poison is so strong that even the weapon-refining apprentices cannot touch it. Two of them were burned in the past two days."

    He paused.

    "No one dares to touch that batch of things. I told the superiors that they will be distributed to you. There are three boxes in the backyard."

    Chen Qingshan lowered his head.

    Almost laughed.

    "...Thank you, Senior Brother Zhang."

    "Thank me?" Zhang Hu's eyes widened, "Your brain isn't burned out, is it? That thing burned your spiritual veins when it touched it!"

    "Disciple, I have a way to put a layer of separation on my hands." Chen Qingshan quickly added, "I can handle it."

    Zhang Hu looked him up and down and shrugged.

    "You can take it if you want. Don't rely on me if you die."

    After that, he left.

    He walked to the door and paused without looking back: "By the way, I also swept the backyard after moving. There is a lot of dust."

    Chen Qingshan followed Zhang Hu to the backyard. Three wooden boxes were piled in the corner. The boxes were corroded by the fire poison and turned dark red. They were closer to the heat wave.

    He knelt down and opened the first box.

    The crimson aura rushed out, causing him to squint his eyes.
title_en: Chapter 8: One month, third level of Qi training
